count_definition: A Pokemon sprite design is one unique non-shiny FRONT visual after exact duplicates and palette-only recolors are collapsed. Genuinely different designs for the same custom identity are all retained and counted.
important_policy: Normal and shiny roles are never compared against each other.
No files are deleted by this audit.
Exact duplicates and palette-only recolors are isolated as cleanup candidates.
Different custom-mon designs are preserved for the approval sheet.
